name: Camp War
subtitle: Two camps, one front
description: The Allied Forces (olive-drab riflemen, jeeps, Mustangs and PT boats; blue markings) on the left and the Axis Forces (field-grey grenadiers, sidecar bikes, Stukas and E-boats; red markings) on the right. Each camp is ringed by a sandbag perimeter with four watchtowers, an anti-tank ditch crossed by one checkpoint, tank traps in front of the gate and a headquarters bunker in the middle. Troops muster in the camp and counter-attack when the enemy comes near. Field guns and howitzers roll out with the army and shell the enemy's perimeter, checkpoint, towers and tank traps; tanks and halftracks breach what is left. A side that gathers a strong force in the middle pushes on the enemy's headquarters. Nobody wins: the battle goes on for as long as the program runs. Trenches and old shell holes scar the middle of the field and give men cover.

actions.text: Allied engineers throw up tank traps and machine-gun nests.
The Allied camp digs foxholes and more gun nests.
Axis engineers throw up tank traps and machine-gun nests.
The Axis camp digs foxholes and more gun nests.
Armour and heavy guns roll up behind the fifth wave.
Both camps bring up a field gun.
Both camps haul a howitzer into position.
The Allied camp counter-attacks through the west checkpoint!
The Allied garrison pours out of the west checkpoint, rifles ready.
The Allied west checkpoint is sealed again.
The Axis camp counter-attacks through the east checkpoint!
The Axis garrison pours out of the east checkpoint, rifles ready.
The Axis east checkpoint is sealed again.
The Allies push on the Axis headquarters!
The Axis push on the Allied headquarters!
Allied rocket batteries open a missile barrage on the middle of the field!
An Axis V-2 rises from the castle!
